user.title: Connect to Wialon
user.description: Enter the web address you use to sign in to Wialon. The API address is detected automatically; fill it in only if detection fails.

data_description.api_url: Leave empty to detect it from the login page.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.description: Choose how Home Assistant gets read-only access to your Wialon account.

oauth.title: Sign in with Wialon
oauth.description: Complete sign-in in the window that opened.

token.title: Access token
token.description: Paste a Wialon access token (72 characters).

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The Wialon access token no longer works. Sign in again with the same account.

error.not_wialon: This address does not look like a Wialon server.

abort.already_configured: This Wialon account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The new token belongs to a different Wialon user.
abort.no_url: No Home Assistant URL is available for the sign-in redirect.
abort.not_wialon: This address does not look like a Wialon server.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Backfills hourly long-term statistics from the messages Wialon has stored, for the enabled numeric sensors of the selected units. Only hours before each sensor's first existing statistic are written. Binary sensors and the device tracker are not imported, because Home Assistant has no supported way to backfill states. Runs in the background and posts a notification when done.

device_id.name: Units
device_id.description: Wialon units to import. Leave empty for all selected units.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days back to import (1 to 366).
